narrative: A cleaner leaf than Wednesday's. The same entrance. The half-line stops. The blank after it is empty on purpose. No song at the foot. The same leaf, lower down. The half-line above is still empty. This sentence is theirs. No last line of the play is under it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Copied the entrance, wrote the year, and did not close the act.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on draft in The half-line, still empty
